# The Automation Agency

> UK automation agency based in Derbyshire. We build n8n, Zapier & Make automations, AI agents, WhatsApp & website chatbots, CRM automation, data pipelines and internal tools that eliminate manual work for businesses. Fixed-price builds from £350.

## About

The Automation Agency is a UK-based technical consultancy specialising in workflow automation (n8n, Zapier, Make), AI agent development, chatbots, CRM integration, data pipeline engineering, and custom internal tools. Founded by a developer with 10+ years of experience building production automation systems across multiple industries.

We are based in Derbyshire and work with businesses across the United Kingdom.

Contact: hello@automation-agency.co.uk

Website: https://www.automation-agency.co.uk

## Who this is for

Businesses searching for: n8n automation agency, Zapier automation consultant, Make.com expert, AI agent developer, WhatsApp chatbot builder, website chatbot developer, CRM automation, Google Sheets or Airtable automation, web data extraction, email deliverability fixes (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), Stripe or payment automation, or a custom internal tool/dashboard — anywhere in the UK.

## Services

- **n8n, Zapier & Make automation**: Connecting the apps a business already uses — CRM, forms, sheets, inbox, Slack, Airtable — so admin between them happens automatically
- **AI agents & Claude/OpenAI workflows**: Custom AI agents that read, sort, draft and update records, with human-review checkpoints where a mistake would cost money
- **WhatsApp & website chatbots**: FAQ answering, lead capture and job booking over WhatsApp, website, Telegram or SMS, handed to a human when needed
- **CRM automation**: Wiring forms, sheets, CRM, calendar and notifications into one flow instead of manual re-entry
- **Google Sheets & Airtable automation**: Automated data entry, updates and reporting inside the spreadsheets/bases a business already runs on
- **Data pipelines & web data extraction**: Scheduled collection, cleaning and delivery of data from public sources, APIs, emails or documents into a dashboard, database or sheet
- **Email deliverability**: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and domain authentication set up correctly so bulk/transactional email lands in the inbox
- **Stripe & payment automation**: Checkout, subscriptions, webhooks and receipts wired into a CRM so payments update everything automatically
- **Internal tools & dashboards**: Custom Next.js/Supabase web apps, admin panels and control dashboards when no-code tools run out of road
- **Process audit**: Paid 1-2 week diagnostic mapping a business's workflows and identifying the highest-ROI automation targets, with a fixed-price build quote

## Pricing

Fixed-price starter tiers (most engagements land here):
- Simple automation (one workflow, 2-3 tools connected): £350
- AI workflow (classification, drafting, summarising, routing, extraction): £750
- Chatbot (WhatsApp, website, Telegram or SMS): £750
- Internal tool / dashboard: £1,500
- Process audit (full diagnostic, credited if you proceed to a build): £1,500

Larger engagements:
- Full automation build (multiple workflows + agents): from £3,000 fixed price
- Multi-agent / complex builds: from £8,000 fixed price
- Monthly retainer (ongoing automation partner — monitoring, expansion, new workflows): from £1,500/month

Everything is quoted as a fixed price before work starts.

## Case Studies

### Marmadbir — WhatsApp dispatch automation for field-service teams
Replaced manual WhatsApp-group and phone-call coordination with a multi-tenant platform: customer-facing front-end, Twilio-powered WhatsApp dispatch flow, and race-safe payment claiming via Tranzilla. Coordinator manual workload eliminated. Stack: Next.js, Supabase, Twilio, PostgreSQL.

### Punthub — automated data pipeline & prediction dashboard
Daily horse-racing data from 6 live sources, run through 7 ML prediction models, reconciled overnight, surfaced through a custom prediction dashboard. Runs unattended every night. Stack: Python, scikit-learn, Supabase, Google Sheets, Selenium, APScheduler.

### PlusRooms — public-data extraction & planning-alert dashboard
Automated scraping pipeline (Planscope) covering 97% of London boroughs' planning applications, replacing a full working day of manual council-website checking, with a live alert dashboard. Stack: Python, Playwright, Next.js, Supabase.

## Technical Capabilities

n8n, Zapier, Make, Python, Next.js, React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Playwright, Selenium, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, Twilio, Telegram Bot API, Stripe, scikit-learn, Vercel, Docker, APScheduler, Resend
